audience: marketers who send newsletters with rapidmail

useCases.title: Check how a newsletter performed
useCases.text: The AI lists mailings by status, list or send date and reads the statistics of a sent mailing: opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscriptions.

useCases.title: See who opened, clicked or bounced in a mailing
useCases.text: The AI lists the recipients of a mailing with what each did (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced) and opens one recipient's details.

useCases.title: Check new subscriptions and unsubscriptions of a list
useCases.text: The AI reads the subscription activity of a recipient list between two dates (up to one year) so you can see how the list grows.

useCases.title: Find a subscriber in a list
useCases.text: The AI searches one recipient list by email address, external id or status and opens a recipient with name, custom fields and timestamps.

useCases.title: Add, update or unsubscribe a recipient
useCases.text: The AI adds one recipient to a list (double opt-in by default, with one confirmation email), changes email, name or custom fields, or unsubscribes one recipient.

useCases.title: Check blocked addresses and transactional email status
useCases.text: The AI lists blacklist entries (addresses, domains, patterns) and transactional emails with status, delivery diagnostics and open and click counts.
